steps.title: Bem-vindo: Family - Volume 1
steps.text: In this A1-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Family". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: My cousins are twins, they look identical.
She's an only child, so she grew up alone.
My grandparents live in the countryside.

steps.text: It means: "To face a difficult situation with courage.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: I hate going to the dentist, but I'll just have to bite the bullet.
